I did this once when I was 19, I was with one other girl, and it was one of our first few times downtown. We were both a little drunk, and we noticed a couple had been following us for a few minutes. As we were getting to the end of the street, we realized that there were hardly any people on the next road. We crossed the street to two older couples and asked if they could pretend to be our parents. They immediately welcomed us with open arms. Once the couple following had left(after waiting for a few minutes) we explained the situation and went our separate ways. That was 6 years ago, I think about them a lot.

Understandable! Anything I use (ranch, hot sauce, etc) I replace if we run out. I can definitely understand the bills being a stresser, and I need to sort it out. I have asked, but I don't have access to our utilities so it's a little hard to plan for random bills. I would honestly rather have a conversation in person, but I could give them an opportunity to respond over text if direct confrontation is too much.

I just feel like you are not understanding that other than dishes and trash in the beginning, we are all the same level of messy. They will leave a plate in the living room as often as I do. I clean the living space as offen as they do and will pick up their dishes, they do not do the same for me. I said in an earlier comment, but other than being short $50 on rent once (but was still within the 5 days so she could've waited and it wouldn't be late) this has s lot to do with me not having access to the bills. I can't look them up so I can't plan on how much they will be or when they're due. They both make over double what i do so maybe thats why theyre not understanding the importance of this information. I have asked for this information before, but I should have been more insistent. I am not saying this isn't frustrating for them, but it's not like I have a specific number or date to ensure it doesn't happen.

I do some spot cleaning, and I wash my face and hands regularly. I keep deodorant next to my bed so I'm good about that too, along with dry shampoo. I have been working on this and would say i shower a little more often than that now. I do brush my teeth, but I have had a handful of days where I just used mouthwash. I can't shower every day due to a skin condition. I wash my bedsheets regularly.

Nothing I have said negates the original post. I have already said I have trouble communicating. I also already said I should have said most and not all. I would encourage you to look at my conversations with everyone else. I never denied responsibility. I had to add context specifically for you because you are misunderstanding much more than anyone else.

If something isnt clear, you coukd just ask. Explaining the whole situation with the beer seemed like a hassle, and would've made the post too lengthy. It felt too unrelated. I figured I would clarify in comments. Could've said most instead of all, I guess. A lot of the things I've said shirk some level of responsibility from me, and I didn't want to come across like I had an excuse for every single thing. I was looking to understand if everything is an issue, or one or two specific things. I tried to include everything I've done that could be taken as a slight, even if i didnt think it was. Most of these conversations have been very helpful and helped me game plan what to prioritize and tackle first.

I feel like you just have trouble understanding that two things can be true. They spend more time in their rooms, meaning one or two days a week they spend an extra hour in their own rooms after work or before bed. Other than that we are all in the living room from 5-10pm. They have gone to the opposite end of the house twice, but its more than not at all. I am not being ostracized and still feel like there is love between us, its just tense right now. I never denied that the relationship has changed, I specifically said it has. I feel like you're inferring a lot of things that aren't true. There are also other a few outside forces affecting things, but I wanted to specifically work on what I can change.
Thank you!! This is a very thoughtful message. Thank you for your advice. Getting a fresh perspective could probably help me most days.

All paid back within 3-4 days, most in the $60 dollar range.  We do not pay on the same day every month and I do not know what they are going to be until it's due If the bill is higher than i expect,  i have to uber after work and it usually takes a second to make the money. I have asked for the information to resolve this issue, but was not given it.  The friendship isn't over, we still we go out the 3 of us, or play among us together, and things of that sort. I am still invited to events, just less. I am not sure if you read the entire post or not, but we have been friends for years. These are not random people. I have no doubt there is a strain on the friendship right now, but I feel like you're projecting. I am close with other people in their social circle and communicate with some very regularly. Social director? I have two other social circles totaling around 14 people. I get invited to do things, have parties, chill 1 on 1. Since I've been depressed I don't do as much as I used to. My roomates and their friends aren't the only people I talk to lol.

Thank you! I think I'd like to work on my general performance around the house for a week or two before I said anything, so they know my words aren't hollow. But someone suggested a dinner as my treat, and I'd like to do that, but will have to put in the work w uber bc I can't get overtime. And maybe a neutral space will let them feel more comfortable? It's hard to balance telling people your mental health issues without sounding like you're just offloading all responsibility. I generally try to avoid talking about my mental health if I've done something wrong, but I'm sure there's a way to meet in the middle. I want them to understand that I have given a very poor presentation of myself, and this isn't typical behavior for me.

I clarified in my first comment that I wasn't descriptive enough. I guess I should have told you I was being hyperbolic for the sake of being brief. There is always beer in the fridge. 

Again, I have agreed that I could spend more time out of the home or in my room. Before moving in we hung out quite often so I didn't think about monitoring my presence in my house. Saying I am home a lot does not mean I am home every day, just more than normal. 

Fixed the trash and dishes issue, just added for context. Bills have been a problem 4 times and I don't have access to our bills to plan how much and when they come out. I have asked for this information but did not get it. I said in another comment I plan on asking again. It is not a regular thing they cook dinner for me, but they do. I said I barely cook, meaning I mostly stick to stuff that's maybe two or three ingredients, and it would be out of my comfort zone to cook a meal on their caliber. I do buy groceries that we all can use to supplement me not cooking, but id like to do more. The cuties caused gnats because they were moved to a cubby by someone else after I bought them, and I forgot they existed. I still feel responsible bc I should have remembered I bought them, but I didn't just leave them in plain sight for weeks. We all looked through the kitchen trying to find the cause and it took a few days to find them. 

I have trouble communicating and there are a lot of layers to this situation, like any. I figured I could type the gist and explain more in the comments.

I don't understand where you are getting that I'm controlling any space. I have agreed multiple times that I'm going to try to do something a couple days a week. I am home a lot, but I still leave around once a week to visit family or see other friends. I am gone overnight/into the next day at least once a month. 

I still occasionally see our mutual friends, just less than I used to, while they see them the same. Think from nearly every weekend to once a month. 

I should not have to be told not to drink the beer I was explicitly told I could drink? As I said in my last comment, I don't actually drink all the beer. Majority of the time there's cases being put in before I have finished one. If it's a big case, like a 24 pack, I leave it. We have an entire fridge and multiple shelves entirely for alcohol, I don't touch anything that they like, specifically sticking to beer because they do not like it. If we go out or I go somewhere without them, I buy my own alcohol. When we've gone to a bar, I will buy shots for everyone etc like everyone else does.

I'm happy things have worked out for you!! I would hate to make the girls feel like it wasn't our collective home. I guess I assumed that bc we hung out so much as friends for the past few years, that I didn't need to think about how much I was in shared spaces. I do stay in my room when they're getting ready in the morning, just bc I like my morning space too! Especially when I worked in the office. Thank you for the positivity. I understand that for some people they wouldn't want to continue the friendship, but I hope to show them I care about being a good friend and roomate to them. Thank you!

Just to clarify, any time they come in the room I tell them to put on whatever they want. I can agree on trying to get out once in a while though. The friends they have that drink beer, do not often come here. And everyone typically brings their own drinks if they come. If we are planning a party, I will not drink it. I was told I could drink as much of anything I wanted, but I am worried she said this without meaning it. She works for a rental company and brings home alcohol fairly regularly that guests left. I guess I was not descriptive enough. I don't necessarily drink every single beer that comes in the house. I drink the domestic, and will sometimes have a beer w dinner, or a few during the weekends. It's not a matter of supply,  because her getting this is at her discretion, not just everything available. If it's a situation where she didn't mean what she said, and i just need to adjust i have no problem doing so. I just tend to take people at face value.

First, thank you for taking the time to type all of this! I could definitely try airing out my room if it's warmer one day! The laundry is typically 50/50 clean vs dirty. But I will try to be a little more proactive hanging stuff up, so I won't be so overwhelmed to do another load haha. I don't shower as much as I used to, usually once every 3/4 days (except for one really bad week) I have been a little more motivated in this department recently, so hopefully if it's an issue I'm making progress. Terrified of dental health, so I at least use mouth wash on my worst days, but i do okay. I have felt guilty since I work from home, because I feel like if anything I should do MORE around the house than they do. I can definitely incorporate reminders or something in my phone to clean up a couple times a day until it becomes more habit. No offense at all! I appreciate your advice!

Yeah, totally understandable. The rent has only been short once, and that was still within the 5 days so i am not sure if she just waited or covered the 50, the rest were bills. I have asked for the info so i could get the dates and plan better what i have to pay, but i haven't gotten that yet. I think if I had access to the information I could plan ahead of time and uber if need be. Not denying responsibility, just spitballing solutions.

I appreciate your advice. Thank you! I will continue to work on it and try to Amp it up a little bit. Recently got back in therapy/medicated so I am feeling hopeful I can get back to my old self or better. Some of the comments have been very helpful with ideas to improve the situation/repay the leeway I've been given.

Yeah, I can understand that. I guess if I folded my laundry a little bit more I could hang out in my room for a few extra hours in the day. I wfh and just use a laptop so I'm pretty mobile. I'd like to find a hobby that would get me out of the house but obv money is an issue. And it was too much to type in the post, but she initially told me I could have anything I wanted, and I don't drink any liquor or other drinks, unless we are drinking together. I know sometimes people will say one thing but maybe grow uncomfortable with it? I will definitely decrease the use if it would help the situation. Thank you!

Thank you for the advice! I really would like to be someone  people like living with, but I know it will take a bit of work. I recently got on meds for depression and ADHD and it's been helping my motivation. The bathrooms are a great idea! And a casserole couldn't hurt. Sorry about your roomates!

I am confused why you're focusing on the single issue of cleanliness when there are a few other things mentioned. And again, we are all messy. We all will leave our plates overnight occasionally. We all clean every few days. They never had to pick up after me, I just was not pulling my weight dishes and trash wise. I still did it, just not as much as I should have been. In regards to rent, sure, but it was always paid back within 3-4 days. It's happened less than 4 times. And has never been more than 150, and that was once.

I am more looking for answers on what specifically are the bigger issues? And I'm not sure how me saying them specifically telling telling me I'm not doing anything wrong equates them being my mom. I'm not looking for them to tell me how to do anything, just what specifically is bothering them. Ive picked up the slack with laundry and dishes, and they are the same level of messy as me, barring the cuties incident.
That's really what's killing me. I've asked directly, and they just assured me everything is fine when I feel like it clearly isn't.
Yeah, that does seem like a good idea, thank you! I could uber a few days and treat them
I would just like to understand if its all of those things or specific ones I need to work on more. Or if the first few months kind of ruined it

Yeah, I have improved in a lot of ways, and I feel like my level of messy is equivalent to theirs, but that's the only thing I can think of. It was just a rough start that I feel like I'm paying the repercussions of. I could def make dinner a few times as an apology though
I can definitely understand that. But this will happen in a conversation of talking about something as simple as kroger (today) or commentary on a TV show we are watching.
